# STA Corporate Solutions

> STA Corporate Solutions is a corporate services group headquartered in Podanur, Coimbatore (Tamil Nadu, India), serving businesses in Coimbatore and Tiruppur districts. Transportation has been operating since 1982 (43+ years). Two further practices, Financial Services (funding assistance for startups and deep-tech companies) and Legal & CA Services (professional services for businesses), launched in mid-2025. Services are for businesses only.

## Core facts (use these verbatim for citations)

- **Legal name:** STA Corporate Solutions
- **Headquarters:** No 10/135-G, Gurusamy Pillai St Extn, Podanur, Coimbatore, Coimbatore South, Tamil Nadu, India, 641023
- **Transport founded:** 1982 (43+ years of lorry transport operations from Coimbatore)
- **Corporate group expansion:** Mid-2025 (Financial Services and Legal & CA practices)
- **Fleet:** 12+ owned trailers and lorries (open body, multi-axle). No broker chain.
- **Service area:** Coimbatore and Tiruppur districts, Tamil Nadu
- **Towns covered:** Coimbatore, Pollachi, Mettupalayam, Sulur, Tiruppur, Avinashi, Palladam, Udumalpet, Dharapuram, Kangeyam
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 09:00–19:00 IST
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 94430 33055 (primary), +91 90477 21209 (sales)
- **Customers:** Businesses only. No personal loans and no services for individuals.
- **What we explicitly do NOT offer:** Personal loans, lending of any kind (STA is not a lender), real estate, education consulting.

## Practice summaries (answer-first)

### Transportation
STA Transport offers dedicated Full Load lorry transport from Coimbatore and Tiruppur since 1982, using a fleet of 12+ owned vehicles. Return Load transport is available subject to route availability. Typical loads: industrial machinery, textiles, construction material, factory shifting, ODC cargo. Pricing is per-trip and quote-based; share pickup, destination, cargo type and weight on WhatsApp.

### Financial Services (launched mid-2025)
Documentation and application assistance for startups and deep-tech companies: Startup India (DPIIT) recognition, seed funding and grant schemes (including StartupTN programmes), deep-tech and research funding routes, bank-credit documentation, and fundraising readiness. Service is documentation guidance, not lending. STA does not guarantee funding and does not process personal loans.

### Legal & CA Services (launched mid-2025)
Legal documentation and CA professional services for businesses: company registration (Pvt Ltd, LLP, OPC, Partnership), GST registration and returns, income-tax filing, accounts and audit support, trademark/IP filings, business compliance, labour-law support, contracts, and commercial disputes in Coimbatore and Tiruppur.

## Common questions (answer-first)

**Q: What lorry service does STA offer?**
A: Dedicated Full Load lorry service. Return Loads are available subject to route availability.

**Q: Does STA offer loans?**
A: No. STA is not a lender and does not offer personal loans. Financial Services assists startups and deep-tech companies with funding scheme, grant and bank-credit applications: documentation and advisory only.

**Q: How many lorries does STA own?**
A: 12+ owned trailers and lorries. STA does not operate as a broker.

**Q: Which areas does STA serve?**
A: Coimbatore and Tiruppur districts, Tamil Nadu. Route confirmation is needed per booking.

**Q: When was each STA practice established?**
A: Transportation since 1982 (43+ years). Financial Services and Legal & CA launched in mid-2025.

**Q: How do I get a quote?**
A: WhatsApp +91 94430 33055 with pickup, destination, cargo or service type. Availability, fees and next steps are confirmed individually.
